parameters.query:
with published_candidates as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.category,
    ci.status as content_status,
    p.instagram_media_id,
    p.published_at,
    p.caption_final,
    p.hashtags_final,
    case
      when p.published_at <= now() - interval '24 hours'
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from insight_snapshots s
          where s.content_id = ci.content_id
            and s.platform = 'instagram'
            and s.snapshot_window = '24h'
        ) then '24h'
      when p.published_at <= now() - interval '72 hours'
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from insight_snapshots s
          where s.content_id = ci.content_id
            and s.platform = 'instagram'
            and s.snapshot_window = '72h'
        ) then '72h'
      when p.published_at <= now() - interval '7 days'
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from insight_snapshots s
          where s.content_id = ci.content_id
            and s.platform = 'instagram'
            and s.snapshot_window = '7d'
        ) then '7d'
      else null
    end as snapshot_window
  from content_items ci
  join publishes p on p.content_id = ci.content_id
  where p.platform = 'instagram'
    and p.publish_status = 'published'
    and p.published_at is not null
    and coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.instagram_media_id), ''), '') <> ''
)
select
  content_id,
  title,
  category,
  content_status,
  instagram_media_id,
  published_at,
  caption_final,
  hashtags_final,
  snapshot_window
from published_candidates
where snapshot_window is not null
order by published_at asc, content_id asc
limit 1;

insert into insight_snapshots (
  content_id,
  platform,
  snapshot_window,
  views,
  plays,
  reach,
  likes,
  comments,
  shares,
  saves,
  engagement_rate,
  completion_rate,
  raw_payload_json,
  snapshot_taken_at
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  'instagram',
  '{{$json.snapshot_window_sql}}',
  {{$json.views_sql}},
  {{$json.plays_sql}},
  {{$json.reach_sql}},
  {{$json.likes_sql}},
  {{$json.comments_sql}},
  {{$json.shares_sql}},
  {{$json.saves_sql}},
  {{$json.engagement_rate_sql}},
  {{$json.completion_rate_sql}},
  '{{$json.raw_payload_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  now()
)
returning snapshot_id, content_id, snapshot_window, views, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves, snapshot_taken_at;

  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (

  nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Insight Snapshot SQL Values"].json["error_message_sql"]}}', ''),

    'metrics_collection', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Insight Snapshot SQL Values"].json["metrics_summary_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb,
    'details', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Insight Snapshot SQL Values"].json["details_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, started_at, ended_at;
